latest_release.name: v0.1.15
latest_release.body:
A patch release that replaces three retired default models, adds typed
reasoning content and OpenAI web search, and fixes a number of provider bugs.

## Action required

**googleai, vertex: default embedding model is now `gemini-embedding-001`.**
`embedding-001` now returns 404. The new model produces 3072-dimension
vectors that are not comparable with the old ones, so indexes built with the
old default must be re-embedded (and fixed-size vector columns resized).

**googleai, vertex: default chat model is now `gemini-2.5-flash`.**
`gemini-2.0-flash` is retired. Gemini 2.5 thinks by default and thinking
counts toward `WithMaxTokens`; a very small budget can produce no output,
which now returns `ErrNoContentInResponse` instead of panicking.
Multi-turn tool calling with Gemini 3 is not yet supported (it needs thought
signatures); that is planned for the next release.

**anthropic: default model is now `claude-sonnet-4-6`.**
`claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620` is retired. Clients that set a model are
unaffected.

**Unkeyed struct literals.** No exported API was removed, but
`llms.ThinkingConfig`, `llms.ContentChoice`, `llms.CallOptions` and
`googleai.Options` gained fields, so unkeyed literals of them no longer
compile. Use keyed fields. `ContentChoice` JSON now includes a `Parts` key.

## Behavior changes

- bedrock (Nova): text blocks are joined into one choice instead of one choice per block.
- mistral: non-streaming tool calls stay on the choice that made them, not `Choices[0]`.
- googleai: an error from `StreamingFunc` is now returned (with a nil response).
- anthropic: reasoning-only streaming works; a stream error event ends the call;
  `temperature`/`top_p` are omitted where the model or thinking mode rejects them.
- llms: `ToolCall` JSON round trips keep the function name and arguments;
  wrongly typed fields now return a wrapped `json.UnmarshalTypeError`.
- llamafile: `WithN` and `WithMinLength` no longer set `n_ctx` and `min_p`; use `WithNCtx` and `WithMinP`.
- chains: no longer clear a streaming function set by the caller.
- cohere: invalid input returns an error instead of panicking.
- googleai: `GOOGLE_API_KEY` is used only when no other auth option is given.

## New

- `llms.WithWebSearch` for OpenAI (#1454).
- Typed reasoning parts: `ThinkingContent`, `RedactedThinkingContent` and `ContentChoice.Parts`.
- `ThinkingConfig.Effort` and `Display` (`WithThinkingEffort`, `WithThinkingDisplay`),
  mapped for Anthropic and OpenAI reasoning models.
- `(*ContentResponse).AssistantMessage` for building the next turn of a tool loop.
- anthropic: preserves thinking and multi-part messages across turns; supports claude-fable-5.
- `testing/llmtest.TestModel`, a conformance check for `llms.Model` implementations.

## Fixes

- anthropic: keep every part of system, AI and tool messages (#1456, #1468, #1010);
  accept `redacted_thinking` blocks; replace the retired default model (#1431).
- openai: zero-argument tool schemas include `properties` (#1446);
  `reasoning_effort` only for models that accept it; no `temperature` for search-preview models.
- googleai: send the API key with `WithHTTPClient`; report reasoning support for Gemini 2.5.

## New Contributors

* @majiayu000 made their first contribution in https://github.com/tmc/langchaingo/pull/1454

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tmc/langchaingo/compare/v0.1.14...v0.1.15
